items.question: What are Temi Fagbenle's stats?
items.answer: In the 2026 regular season, Temi Fagbenle averaged 5.9 points, 3.4 rebounds, and 1.0 assists in 25 games for the Toronto Tempo.

items.question: Where has Temi Fagbenle played in the WNBA?
items.answer: Temi Fagbenle has played for the Minnesota Lynx (2017 to 2019), Indiana Fever (2024), Golden State Valkyries (2025) and Toronto Tempo, who signed her in April 2026. Minnesota drafted her 35th overall in 2016.

items.question: How old is Temi Fagbenle?
items.answer: Temi Fagbenle was born September 8, 1992, in Baltimore, Maryland, and grew up mostly in London.

items.question: How tall is Temi Fagbenle?
items.answer: The WNBA lists Temi Fagbenle at 6 feet 5 inches and 180 pounds.

items.question: Who are Temi Fagbenle's parents?
items.answer: Temi Fagbenle is the daughter of Buki and Tunde Fagbenle and has 11 siblings, according to her WNBA bio. Her brother O-T Fagbenle is an actor.

items.question: Did Temi Fagbenle play at Harvard?
items.answer: Yes. Temi Fagbenle played at Harvard and was the 2012-13 Ivy League Rookie of the Year. She finished college at USC in 2015-16, made the All-Pac-12 Team and earned a master's degree there.
